description: Kontrollér prisgrænser og e-mailunikhed på de krævede cafékolonner.

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum] WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.products'::regclass AND c.contype = 'c' AND a.attname = 'price' AND c.conname = 'products_price_positive'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum] WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.customers'::regclass AND c.contype = 'u' AND a.attname = 'email' AND c.conname = 'customers_email_unique'
INSERT INTO products (id, name, category, price) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1, 'Kontrolvare', 'Mad', 0.01 FROM products RETURNING price
assertions.message: Mindste positive ørepris skal kunne gemmes

assertions.sql: INSERT INTO products (id, name, category, price) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1, 'Kontrolvare', 'Mad', 0 FROM products RETURNING price
INSERT INTO products (id, name, category, price) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1, 'Kontrolvare', 'Mad', -0.01 FROM products RETURNING price
INSERT INTO customers (id, name, city, email) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM customers), 'Kontrolkunde', 'Viborg', email FROM customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
assertions.message: En eksisterende e-mail skal afvises som dublet

assertions.sql: INSERT INTO customers (id, name, city, email) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1, 'Kontrolkunde', 'Viborg', gen_random_uuid()::text || '@example.invalid' FROM customers RETURNING name
assertions.message: En ny kunde med en anden e-mail skal kunne indsættes
